parallels.note: Wail, for Yahweh’s day is at hand! It will come as destruction from the Almighty.

translations.web: Alas for the day! For the day of Yahweh is at hand, and it will come as destruction from the Almighty.
translations.bsb: Alas for the day! For the Day of the LORD is near, and it will come as destruction from the Almighty.
translations.kjv: Alas for the day! for the day of the LORD is at hand, and as a destruction from the Almighty shall it come.
translations.asv: Alas for the day! for the day of Jehovah is at hand, and as destruction from the Almighty shall it come.
